local function yes(b)
    return b and 'yes' or 'no'
end
local function copy(a)
    local r={}
    for i,v in ipairs(a) do
        r[i]=v
    end
    return r
end
local function key(a)
    return table.concat(a,',')
end
local function mark(a)
    local r={}
    for i,v in ipairs(a) do
        r[i]=v<0 and 'w' or tostring(v)
    end
    return '('..table.concat(r,',')..')'
end
local function listed(a)
    return #a==0 and 'none' or table.concat(a,' ')
end
local function words(s,sep)
    local a={}
    for w in s:gmatch(sep or '%S+') do
        a[#a+1]=w
    end
    return a
end
local function number(s,lo,hi)
    if #s==0 or #s>10 or not s:match('^%d+$') or (#s>1 and s:sub(1,1)=='0') then
        return nil
    end
    local v=tonumber(s)
    if v>=lo and v<=hi then
        return v
    end
end
local function bad(s)
    error(s,0)
end
local function locate(a,s)
    for i,v in ipairs(a) do
        if v==s then
            return i
        end
    end
end
local function visit(adj,start)
    local seen,q={}, {start};
    seen[start]=true;
    local i=1
    while i<=#q do
        for _,v in ipairs(adj[q[i]]) do
            if not seen[v] then
                seen[v]=true;
                q[#q+1]=v
            end
        end
        i=i+1
    end
    return seen
end
local function all(seen,n)
    for i=1,n do
        if not seen[i] then
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end
local function lex(a,b)
    for i=1,#a do
        if a[i]~=b[i] then
            return a[i]<b[i]
        end
    end
    return false
end
local function gcd(a,b)
    while b~=0 do
        a,b=b,a%b
    end
    return math.abs(a)
end
local function flows(matrix)
    local n,m=#matrix,#matrix[1];
    local rows={}
    for i,r in ipairs(matrix) do
        rows[i]=copy(r);
        for j=1,n do
            rows[i][m+j]=i==j and 1 or 0
        end
    end
    for j=1,m do
        local unique={};
        for _,r in ipairs(rows) do
            if r[j]==0 then
                unique[key(r)]=r
            end
        end
        for _,r in ipairs(rows) do
            if r[j]>0 then
                for _,s in ipairs(rows) do
                    if s[j]<0 then
                        local v,d={},0;
                        for k=1,m+n do
                            v[k]=-s[j]*r[k]+r[j]*s[k];
                            d=gcd(d,v[k])
                        end
                        for k=1,m+n do
                            v[k]=v[k]//d
                        end
                        unique[key(v)]=v
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local values,supports={},{};
        for _,r in pairs(unique) do
            values[#values+1]=r;
            local mask=0;
            for i=1,n do
                if r[m+i]>0 then
                    mask=mask|(1<<(i-1))
                end
            end
            supports[#supports+1]=mask
        end
        rows={};
        for i,r in ipairs(values) do
            local minimal=true;
            for _,s in ipairs(supports) do
                if s~=supports[i] and s&supports[i]==s then
                    minimal=false;
                    break
                end
            end
            if minimal then
                rows[#rows+1]=r
            end
        end
    end
    local result={};
    for _,r in ipairs(rows) do
        local c={}
        for i=1,n do
            c[i]=r[m+i]
        end
        result[#result+1]=c
    end
    table.sort(result,function(a,b)
        return lex(b,a)
    end);
    return result
end
local Net={};
Net.__index=Net
function Net.new(name)
    local n=setmetatable({name=name,p={},t={},initial={},cap={},priority={},pre={},post={},inh={},arcs=0,inhibitors=0,current={},history={}},Net)
    for _,field in ipairs({'pre','post','inh'}) do
        for p=1,16 do
            n[field][p]={}
            for t=1,16 do
                n[field][p][t]=0
            end
        end
    end
    return n
end
function Net:define(w)
    local cmd,n=w[1],#w-1
    if cmd~='place' and cmd~='transition' and cmd~='arc' and cmd~='inhibit' then
        bad('unknown definition '..cmd)
    end
    if not (cmd=='place' and (n==2 or n==3) or cmd=='transition' and (n==1 or n==2) or (cmd=='arc' or cmd=='inhibit') and n==3) then
        bad('wrong number of arguments')
    end
    local a=w[2]
    if cmd=='place' or cmd=='transition' then
        if locate(self.p,a) or locate(self.t,a) then
            bad('duplicate name '..a)
        end
        if cmd=='place' then
            if n==3 and tonumber(w[3])>tonumber(w[4]) then
                bad('tokens exceed capacity of '..a)
            end
            self.p[#self.p+1]=a;
            self.initial[#self.initial+1]=tonumber(w[3]);
            self.cap[#self.cap+1]=n==3 and tonumber(w[4]) or 0
        else
            self.t[#self.t+1]=a;
            self.priority[#self.priority+1]=n==2 and tonumber(w[3]) or 0
        end
    elseif cmd=='arc' then
        local b=w[3];
        for _,x in ipairs({a,b}) do
            if not locate(self.p,x) and not locate(self.t,x) then
                bad('unknown node '..x)
            end
        end
        local pa,pb=locate(self.p,a),locate(self.p,b);
        if (pa~=nil)==(pb~=nil) then
            bad('arc must connect a place and a transition')
        end
        local p,t,mat=pa or pb,locate(self.t,pa and b or a),pa and self.pre or self.post
        if mat[p][t]>0 then
            bad('duplicate arc '..a..' '..b)
        end
        mat[p][t]=tonumber(w[4]);
        self.arcs=self.arcs+1
    else
        local p,t=locate(self.p,a),locate(self.t,w[3]);
        if not p then
            bad('unknown place '..a)
        end
        if not t then
            bad('unknown transition '..w[3])
        end
        if self.inh[p][t]>0 then
            bad('duplicate inhibitor '..a..' '..w[3])
        end
        self.inh[p][t]=tonumber(w[4]);
        self.inhibitors=self.inhibitors+1
    end
end
function Net:reason(m,t)
    for p,name in ipairs(self.p) do
        if m[p]>=0 and m[p]<self.pre[p][t] then
            return 'insufficient tokens in '..name
        end
    end
    for p,name in ipairs(self.p) do
        if self.inh[p][t]>0 and (m[p]<0 or m[p]>=self.inh[p][t]) then
            return 'inhibited by '..name
        end
    end
    for p,name in ipairs(self.p) do
        if self.cap[p]>0 and (m[p]<0 or m[p]-self.pre[p][t]+self.post[p][t]>self.cap[p]) then
            return 'capacity of '..name..' exceeded'
        end
    end
end
function Net:enabled(m)
    local a={}
    for t=1,#self.t do
        if not self:reason(m,t) then
            a[#a+1]=t
        end
    end
    return a
end
function Net:fire(m,t)
    local a={}
    for p,v in ipairs(m) do
        a[p]=v<0 and -1 or v-self.pre[p][t]+self.post[p][t]
    end
    return a
end
function Net:commit(t)
    self.history[#self.history+1]=self.current;
    self.current=self:fire(self.current,t)
end
function Net:names(ts)
    local a={}
    for i,t in ipairs(ts) do
        a[i]=self.t[t]
    end
    return a
end
function Net:graph(start,limit,target)
    local g={states={copy(start)},parent={0},via={0},edges={{}},found=0,aborted=false};
    local index={[key(start)]=1}
    local function matches(m)
        if not target then
            return false
        end
        for p,v in ipairs(m) do
            if v<target[p][1] or target[p][2]>=0 and v~=target[p][2] then
                return false
            end
        end
        return true
    end
    if matches(start) then
        g.found=1;
        return g
    end
    local q=1;
    while q<=#g.states do
        for _,t in ipairs(self:enabled(g.states[q])) do
            local m=self:fire(g.states[q],t);
            local k=index[key(m)]
            if not k then
                if #g.states==limit then
                    g.aborted=true;
                    return g
                end
                k=#g.states+1;
                index[key(m)]=k;
                g.states[k]=m;
                g.parent[k]=q;
                g.via[k]=t;
                g.edges[k]={};
                if matches(m) then
                    g.found=k;
                    return g
                end
            end
            g.edges[q][#g.edges[q]+1]={t,k}
        end
        q=q+1
    end
    return g
end
function Net:path(g,k)
    local a={}
    while g.parent[k]>0 do
        table.insert(a,1,g.via[k]);
        k=g.parent[k]
    end
    return a
end
function Net:reach(limit,display)
    local g=self:graph(self.current,limit);
    if g.aborted then
        print('reachability graph limit '..limit..' exceeded');
        return
    end
    local N=#g.states
    if display then
        for i,m in ipairs(g.states) do
            local a={}
            for _,e in ipairs(g.edges[i]) do
                a[#a+1]=self.t[e[1]]..'->M'..(e[2]-1)
            end
            print('M'..(i-1)..' '..mark(m)..': '..(#a==0 and 'dead' or table.concat(a,' ')))
        end
        return
    end
    local adj,closure,comp={},{},{};
    for i,e in ipairs(g.edges) do
        adj[i]={};
        for _,v in ipairs(e) do
            adj[i][#adj[i]+1]=v[2]
        end
    end
    for i=1,N do
        closure[i]=visit(adj,i)
    end
    local count=0;
    for i=1,N do
        if not comp[i] then
            count=count+1;
            for j=i,N do
                if closure[i][j] and closure[j][i] then
                    comp[j]=count
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local terminal,home,maximum,dead={},{},{},{};
    for c=1,count do
        terminal[c]=true
    end
    for i=1,N do
        home[i]=true
    end
    for p=1,#self.p do
        maximum[p]=0
    end
    local edgeCount,persistent=0,true
    for i,m in ipairs(g.states) do
        if #g.edges[i]==0 then
            dead[#dead+1]=i
        end
        edgeCount=edgeCount+#g.edges[i];
        for p,v in ipairs(m) do
            maximum[p]=math.max(maximum[p],v)
        end
        for j=1,N do
            home[j]=home[j] and closure[i][j]
        end
        for _,e in ipairs(g.edges[i]) do
            local t,k=e[1],e[2];
            if comp[i]~=comp[k] then
                terminal[comp[i]]=false
            end
            for _,f in ipairs(g.edges[i]) do
                if t~=f[1] and self:reason(g.states[k],f[1]) then
                    persistent=false
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local terminals,homes=0,0;
    for c=1,count do
        if terminal[c] then
            terminals=terminals+1
        end
    end
    for i=1,N do
        if home[i] then
            homes=homes+1
        end
    end
    print('reachable markings: '..N);
    print('edges: '..edgeCount);
    print('components: '..count..' (terminal '..terminals..')');
    print('dead markings: '..#dead)
    for _,i in ipairs(dead) do
        local a=self:names(self:path(g,i));
        print('  M'..(i-1)..' '..mark(g.states[i])..' path '..(#a==0 and 'empty' or table.concat(a,' ')))
    end
    local bound=math.max(table.unpack(maximum));
    print('max tokens: '..mark(maximum));
    print('bound: '..bound);
    print('safe: '..yes(bound<=1));
    print('home markings: '..homes);
    print('reversible: '..yes(home[1]));
    print('persistent: '..yes(persistent))
    local levels={};
    for t,name in ipairs(self.t) do
        local present,used,cycle={},false,false;
        for i,e in ipairs(g.edges) do
            for _,v in ipairs(e) do
                if v[1]==t then
                    used=true;
                    present[comp[i]]=true;
                    if comp[i]==comp[v[2]] then
                        cycle=true
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        local live=true;
        for c=1,count do
            if terminal[c] and not present[c] then
                live=false
            end
        end
        levels[t]=name..'='..(live and 'L4' or cycle and 'L3' or used and 'L1' or 'L0')
    end
    print('liveness: '..table.concat(levels,' '))
end
function Net:cover(limit)
    local states,parent,via,old,dead={copy(self.current)},{0},{0},{false},{false};
    local function rank(v)
        return v<0 and math.huge or v
    end
    local q=1;
    while q<=#states do
        if not old[q] then
            local es=self:enabled(states[q]);
            dead[q]=#es==0;
            local anc={};
            local a=q;
            while a>0 do
                table.insert(anc,1,a);
                a=parent[a]
            end
            for _,t in ipairs(es) do
                local m=self:fire(states[q],t);
                for _,a in ipairs(anc) do
                    local ge,gt=true,false;
                    for p,v in ipairs(m) do
                        ge=ge and rank(v)>=rank(states[a][p]);
                        gt=gt or rank(v)>rank(states[a][p])
                    end
                    if ge and gt then
                        for p,v in ipairs(m) do
                            if self.cap[p]==0 and rank(v)>rank(states[a][p]) then
                                m[p]=-1
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if #states==limit then
                    print('coverability tree limit '..limit..' exceeded');
                    return
                end
                local seen=false;
                for _,s in ipairs(states) do
                    if key(s)==key(m) then
                        seen=true;
                        break
                    end
                end
                local k=#states+1;
                old[k]=seen;
                states[k]=m;
                parent[k]=q;
                via[k]=t;
                dead[k]=false
            end
        end
        q=q+1
    end
    print('coverability tree nodes: '..#states);
    local maximum={}
    for p=1,#self.p do
        maximum[p]=0
    end
    for i,m in ipairs(states) do
        print('  '..(i-1)..' '..mark(m)..' '..(i==1 and 'root' or '<- '..(parent[i]-1)..' '..self.t[via[i]])..(old[i] and ' old' or '')..(dead[i] and ' dead' or ''));
        for p,v in ipairs(m) do
            if rank(v)>rank(maximum[p]) then
                maximum[p]=v
            end
        end
    end
    local unbounded={}
    for p,v in ipairs(maximum) do
        if v<0 then
            unbounded[#unbounded+1]=self.p[p]
        end
    end
    print('bounds: '..mark(maximum));
    print('unbounded: '..listed(unbounded))
end
function Net:sets(trap)
    local found={};
    for mask=1,(1<<#self.p)-1 do
        local valid=true;
        for t=1,#self.t do
            local input,output=false,false;
            for p=1,#self.p do
                if mask&(1<<(p-1))~=0 then
                    input=input or self.post[p][t]>0;
                    output=output or self.pre[p][t]>0
                end
            end
            if trap and output and not input or not trap and input and not output then
                valid=false;
                break
            end
        end
        if valid then
            found[#found+1]=mask
        end
    end
    local result={};
    for _,m in ipairs(found) do
        local minimal=true;
        for _,s in ipairs(found) do
            if s~=m and s&m==s then
                minimal=false;
                break
            end
        end
        if minimal then
            result[#result+1]=m
        end
    end
    local function bits(m)
        local a={}
        for p=1,#self.p do
            if m&(1<<(p-1))~=0 then
                a[#a+1]=p
            end
        end
        return a
    end
    table.sort(result,function(a,b)
        local x,y=bits(a),bits(b);
        if #x~=#y then
            return #x<#y
        end
        return lex(x,y)
    end);
    return result
end
function Net:setText(mask)
    local a={}
    for p,name in ipairs(self.p) do
        if mask&(1<<(p-1))~=0 then
            a[#a+1]=name
        end
    end
    return '{'..table.concat(a,',')..'}'
end
function Net:realize(counts)
    local used,stack,choices,path,seen={},{self.current},{1},{},{};
    local total=0;
    for t,v in ipairs(counts) do
        used[t]=0;
        total=total+v
    end
    while #stack>0 do
        local d=#path+1;
        if #path==total then
            return path
        end
        local chosen
        for t=choices[d],#counts do
            choices[d]=t+1;
            if used[t]<counts[t] and not self:reason(stack[d],t) then
                used[t]=used[t]+1;
                local k=key(used);
                used[t]=used[t]-1;
                if not seen[k] then
                    seen[k]=true;
                    chosen=t;
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        if chosen then
            used[chosen]=used[chosen]+1;
            path[#path+1]=chosen;
            stack[#stack+1]=self:fire(stack[d],chosen);
            choices[#choices+1]=1
        else
            table.remove(stack);
            table.remove(choices);
            if #path>0 then
                local t=table.remove(path);
                used[t]=used[t]-1
            end
        end
    end
end
function Net:invariants(transpose)
    local a={};
    if transpose then
        for t=1,#self.t do
            a[t]={}
            for p=1,#self.p do
                a[t][p]=self.post[p][t]-self.pre[p][t]
            end
        end
    else
        for p=1,#self.p do
            a[p]={}
            for t=1,#self.t do
                a[p][t]=self.post[p][t]-self.pre[p][t]
            end
        end
    end
    local f,ns=flows(a),transpose and self.t or self.p;
    local covered,bounds={},{};
    print((transpose and 'T' or 'P')..'-semiflows: '..#f)
    for _,c in ipairs(f) do
        local terms,value={},0;
        for i,v in ipairs(c) do
            if v>0 then
                terms[#terms+1]=(v==1 and '' or v..'*')..ns[i];
                covered[i]=true;
                if not transpose then
                    value=value+v*self.current[i]
                end
            end
        end
        local text=table.concat(terms,' + ')
        if transpose then
            local path=self:realize(c);
            print('  '..text..': '..(path and 'realizable '..table.concat(self:names(path),' ') or 'not realizable'))
        else
            print('  '..text..' = '..value);
            for p,v in ipairs(c) do
                if v>0 then
                    local b=value//v;
                    bounds[p]=bounds[p] and math.min(bounds[p],b) or b
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if not transpose then
        local b={}
        for p=1,#ns do
            b[p]=bounds[p] and tostring(bounds[p]) or '-'
        end
        print('bounds: ('..table.concat(b,',')..')')
    end
    print((transpose and 'consistent: ' or 'conservative: ')..yes(all(covered,#ns)))
end
function Net:classify()
    local ordinary,pure,sm,mg,fc,efc=true,true,true,true,true,true;
    local inputs,outputs={},{};
    for t=1,#self.t do
        inputs[t]={}
    end
    for p=1,#self.p do
        outputs[p]={};
        for t=1,#self.t do
            ordinary=ordinary and self.pre[p][t]<=1 and self.post[p][t]<=1;
            pure=pure and not(self.pre[p][t]>0 and self.post[p][t]>0);
            if self.pre[p][t]>0 then
                inputs[t][#inputs[t]+1]=p;
                outputs[p][#outputs[p]+1]=t
            end
        end
    end
    for t=1,#self.t do
        local count=0;
        for p=1,#self.p do
            if self.post[p][t]>0 then
                count=count+1
            end
        end
        sm=sm and #inputs[t]==1 and count==1
    end
    for p,a in ipairs(outputs) do
        local count=0;
        for t=1,#self.t do
            if self.post[p][t]>0 then
                count=count+1
            end
        end
        mg=mg and #a==1 and count==1;
        for _,t in ipairs(a) do
            if #a~=1 and #inputs[t]~=1 then
                fc=false
            end
        end
        for q,b in ipairs(outputs) do
            for _,t in ipairs(a) do
                if self.pre[q][t]>0 and key(a)~=key(b) then
                    efc=false
                end
            end
        end
    end
    sm=sm and ordinary;
    mg=mg and ordinary;
    fc=fc and ordinary;
    efc=efc and ordinary
    for _,v in ipairs({{'ordinary',ordinary},{'pure',pure},{'state machine',sm},{'marked graph',mg},{'free choice',fc},{'extended free choice',efc}}) do
        print(v[1]..': '..yes(v[2]))
    end
    local verdict=not fc and 'not applicable' or #self.p>12 and 'too many places' or 'holds'
    if fc and #self.p<=12 then
        local traps=self:sets(true);
        for _,s in ipairs(self:sets(false)) do
            local holds=false;
            for _,q in ipairs(traps) do
                if s&q==q then
                    for p,v in ipairs(self.current) do
                        if v>0 and q&(1<<(p-1))~=0 then
                            holds=true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if not holds then
                verdict='fails at '..self:setText(s);
                break
            end
        end
    end
    print('commoner: '..verdict)
end
function Net:workflow(limit)
    local sources,sinks={},{};
    for p=1,#self.p do
        local input,output=false,false;
        for t=1,#self.t do
            input=input or self.post[p][t]>0;
            output=output or self.pre[p][t]>0
        end
        if not input then
            sources[#sources+1]=p
        end
        if not output then
            sinks[#sinks+1]=p
        end
    end
    if #sources~=1 then
        print('workflow: no ('..#sources..' source places)');
        return
    end
    if #sinks~=1 then
        print('workflow: no ('..#sinks..' sink places)');
        return
    end
    local i,o,P=sources[1],sinks[1],#self.p;
    local ns,adj,rev=copy(self.p),{},{};
    for _,name in ipairs(self.t) do
        ns[#ns+1]=name
    end
    for v=1,#ns do
        adj[v]={};
        rev[v]={}
    end
    for p=1,P do
        for t=1,#self.t do
            if self.pre[p][t]>0 then
                adj[p][#adj[p]+1]=P+t;
                rev[P+t][#rev[P+t]+1]=p
            end
            if self.post[p][t]>0 then
                adj[P+t][#adj[P+t]+1]=p;
                rev[p][#rev[p]+1]=P+t
            end
        end
    end
    local f,b=visit(adj,i),visit(rev,o);
    for v,name in ipairs(ns) do
        if not f[v] or not b[v] then
            print('workflow: no ('..name..' is not on a path from '..self.p[i]..' to '..self.p[o]..')');
            return
        end
    end
    print('workflow: source '..self.p[i]..' sink '..self.p[o])
    local start,goal={},{};
    for p=1,P do
        start[p]=p==i and 1 or 0;
        goal[p]=p==o and 1 or 0
    end
    local g=self:graph(start,limit);
    if g.aborted then
        print('reachability graph limit '..limit..' exceeded');
        return
    end
    local finish,used,proper=nil,{},true;
    rev={};
    for u=1,#g.states do
        rev[u]={}
    end
    for u,m in ipairs(g.states) do
        if key(m)==key(goal) then
            finish=u
        end
        if m[o]>=1 and key(m)~=key(goal) then
            proper=false
        end
        for _,e in ipairs(g.edges[u]) do
            rev[e[2]][#rev[e[2]]+1]=u;
            used[e[1]]=true
        end
    end
    local option=finish~=nil and all(visit(rev,finish),#g.states);
    local live=all(used,#self.t);
    print('option to complete: '..yes(option));
    print('proper completion: '..yes(proper));
    print('no dead transitions: '..yes(live));
    print('sound: '..yes(option and proper and live))
end
local arity={MARKING=0,RESET=0,SET=2,ENABLED=0,FIRE=-1,UNDO=1,SIMULATE=3,CONFLICTS=0,REACH=1,GRAPH=1,COVER=1,PATH=2,INCIDENCE=0,PINV=0,TINV=0,SIPHONS=0,TRAPS=0,CLASSIFY=0,WORKFLOW=1,SHOW=0}
function Net:execute(w)
    local cmd=w[1];
    if arity[cmd]==nil then
        bad('unknown command '..cmd)
    end
    if arity[cmd]<0 and #w<2 or arity[cmd]>=0 and #w~=arity[cmd]+1 then
        bad('wrong number of arguments')
    end
    local limit;
    if cmd=='REACH' or cmd=='GRAPH' or cmd=='COVER' or cmd=='PATH' or cmd=='WORKFLOW' then
        limit=number(w[2],1,2000);
        if not limit then
            bad('invalid limit '..w[2])
        end
    end
    if cmd=='MARKING' or cmd=='RESET' then
        if cmd=='RESET' then
            self.current=copy(self.initial);
            self.history={}
        end
        print('marking '..mark(self.current))
    elseif cmd=='SET' then
        local p=locate(self.p,w[2]);
        if not p then
            bad('unknown place '..w[2])
        end
        local v=number(w[3],0,999);
        if not v then
            bad('invalid tokens '..w[3])
        end
        if self.cap[p]>0 and v>self.cap[p] then
            bad('tokens exceed capacity of '..w[2])
        end
        self.current=copy(self.current);
        self.current[p]=v;
        self.history={};
        print('marking '..mark(self.current))
    elseif cmd=='ENABLED' then
        print('enabled: '..listed(self:names(self:enabled(self.current))))
    elseif cmd=='FIRE' then
        local ts={}
        for i=2,#w do
            local t=locate(self.t,w[i]);
            if not t then
                bad('unknown transition '..w[i])
            end
            ts[#ts+1]=t
        end
        for i,t in ipairs(ts) do
            local reason=self:reason(self.current,t);
            if reason then
                print('step '..i..': '..self.t[t]..' not enabled ('..reason..') at '..mark(self.current));
                return
            end
            self:commit(t)
        end
        print('fired '..#ts..' -> '..mark(self.current))
    elseif cmd=='UNDO' then
        local k=number(w[2],1,1000);
        if not k then
            bad('invalid count '..w[2])
        end
        local h=#self.history;
        if k>h then
            bad('cannot undo '..k..': history size '..h)
        end
        self.current=self.history[h-k+1];
        for _=1,k do
            table.remove(self.history)
        end
        print('marking '..mark(self.current))
    elseif cmd=='SIMULATE' then
        local steps,x=number(w[2],1,1000),number(w[3],1,2147483646);
        if not steps then
            bad('invalid steps '..w[2])
        end
        if not x then
            bad('invalid seed '..w[3])
        end
        if w[4]~='PRIORITY' and w[4]~='RANDOM' then
            bad('invalid mode '..w[4])
        end
        local counts={}
        for t=1,#self.t do
            counts[t]=0
        end
        local done=0
        while done<steps do
            local e=self:enabled(self.current);
            if #e==0 then print('dead (steps='..done..')');break end
            local t=e[1];
            if w[4]=='RANDOM' then
                x=x*48271%2147483647;
                t=e[x%#e+1]
            else
                for _,u in ipairs(e) do
                    if self.priority[u]>self.priority[t] then
                        t=u
                    end
                end
            end
            self:commit(t);
            counts[t]=counts[t]+1;
            done=done+1;
            print('step '..done..': '..self.t[t]..' -> '..mark(self.current))
        end
        if done==steps then
            print('completed (steps='..steps..')')
        end
        local a={}
        for t,name in ipairs(self.t) do
            a[t]=name..'='..counts[t]
        end
        print('counts: '..table.concat(a,' '))
    elseif cmd=='CONFLICTS' then
        local s,e={},{};
        for u=1,#self.t do
            for v=u+1,#self.t do
                local pair=self.t[u]..'/'..self.t[v];
                local conflict=false;
                for p=1,#self.p do
                    if self.pre[p][u]>0 and self.pre[p][v]>0 then
                        conflict=true
                    end
                end
                if conflict then
                    s[#s+1]=pair
                end
                if not self:reason(self.current,u) and not self:reason(self.current,v) and (self:reason(self:fire(self.current,u),v) or self:reason(self:fire(self.current,v),u)) then
                    e[#e+1]=pair
                end
            end
        end
        print('structural: '..listed(s));
        print('effective: '..listed(e))
    elseif cmd=='REACH' or cmd=='GRAPH' then
        self:reach(limit,cmd=='GRAPH')
    elseif cmd=='COVER' then
        self:cover(limit)
    elseif cmd=='PATH' then
        local entries=words(w[3],'[^,]+');
        if #entries~=#self.p then
            bad('target needs '..#self.p..' entries')
        end
        local target={}
        for _,s in ipairs(entries) do
            if s=='*' then
                target[#target+1]={0,-1}
            else
                local plus=s:sub(-1)=='+';
                local v=number(plus and s:sub(1,-2) or s,0,9999999999);
                if not v then
                    bad('invalid target entry '..s)
                end
                target[#target+1]={v,plus and -1 or v}
            end
        end
        local g=self:graph(self.current,limit,target);
        if g.found>0 then
            local a=self:names(self:path(g,g.found));
            print('reached '..mark(g.states[g.found])..' length='..#a..(#a>0 and ': '..table.concat(a,' ') or ''))
        elseif g.aborted then
            print('search limit '..limit..' exceeded')
        else
            print('unreachable (markings explored: '..#g.states..')')
        end
    elseif cmd=='INCIDENCE' then
        local rows={{''}};
        for _,name in ipairs(self.t) do
            rows[1][#rows[1]+1]=name
        end
        for p,name in ipairs(self.p) do
            local r={name};
            for t=1,#self.t do
                r[#r+1]=tostring(self.post[p][t]-self.pre[p][t])
            end
            rows[#rows+1]=r
        end
        local width={}
        for _,r in ipairs(rows) do
            for i,s in ipairs(r) do
                width[i]=math.max(width[i] or 0,#s)
            end
        end
        for _,r in ipairs(rows) do
            local a={}
            for i,s in ipairs(r) do
                local pad=string.rep(' ',width[i]-#s);
                a[i]=i==1 and s..pad or pad..s
            end
            print((table.concat(a,'  '):gsub(' +$','')))
        end
    elseif cmd=='PINV' or cmd=='TINV' then
        self:invariants(cmd=='TINV')
    elseif cmd=='SIPHONS' or cmd=='TRAPS' then
        if #self.p>12 then
            bad('more than 12 places')
        end
        local ss=self:sets(cmd=='TRAPS');
        print('minimal '..(cmd=='TRAPS' and 'traps' or 'siphons')..': '..#ss);
        for _,s in ipairs(ss) do
            local tokens=0;
            for p,v in ipairs(self.current) do
                if s&(1<<(p-1))~=0 then
                    tokens=tokens+v
                end
            end
            print('  '..self:setText(s)..' tokens='..tokens)
        end
    elseif cmd=='CLASSIFY' then
        self:classify()
    elseif cmd=='WORKFLOW' then
        self:workflow(limit)
    elseif cmd=='SHOW' then
        for p,name in ipairs(self.p) do
            print('place '..name..' tokens='..self.initial[p]..' capacity='..(self.cap[p]>0 and self.cap[p] or 'none'))
        end
        for t,name in ipairs(self.t) do
            local lists={}
            for _,mat in ipairs({self.pre,self.post,self.inh}) do
                local a={}
                for p,pn in ipairs(self.p) do
                    if mat[p][t]>0 then
                        a[#a+1]=pn..':'..mat[p][t]
                    end
                end
                lists[#lists+1]=#a>0 and table.concat(a,',') or '-'
            end
            print('transition '..name..' priority='..self.priority[t]..' pre='..lists[1]..' post='..lists[2]..' inhibit='..lists[3])
        end
    end
end
local blocks=tonumber(io.read())
for _=1,blocks do
    local net=Net.new(words(io.read())[2]);
    while true do
        local line=io.read();
        if line=='END NET' then
            break
        end
        local ok,err=pcall(function()
            net:define(words(line))
        end);
        if not ok then
            print('error: '..err)
        end
    end
    net.current=copy(net.initial);
    print('net '..net.name..': places='..#net.p..' transitions='..#net.t..' arcs='..net.arcs..' inhibitors='..net.inhibitors);
    local n=tonumber(io.read());
    for _=1,n do
        local line=io.read();
        local ok,err=pcall(function()
            net:execute(words(line))
        end);
        if not ok then
            print('error: '..err)
        end
    end
end
